verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Amazon Chime SDK as a real-time communications SDK and documents codecs, bitrates, bandwidth adaptation and hardware acceleration. None of it states an end-to-end latency target or a measured latency path. Latency is a fair axis for a real-time audio/video SDK, so the absence of such documentation yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents an end-to-end latency target or measured latency path suitable for live conversation
